consent_preticked.url: Pre-ticked checkbox opting user into marketing and third party data sharing
consent_preticked.disclaimer: ClearClick AI findings are automated warnings for human review, not legal conclusions.

findings.evidence: Yes, send me promotional newsletters, partner offers, and share my profile with third-party advertising networks.
findings.why: This marketing or data-sharing option is pre-selected by default, enrolling the user unless they take affirmative action to uncheck it.
findings.safer_alternative: Provide an un-ticked checkbox requiring explicit, affirmative opt-in by the user.

consent_asymmetric_buttons.url: Accept button is vibrant green and prominent while Reject is faint grey underlined text
consent_asymmetric_buttons.disclaimer: ClearClick AI findings are automated warnings for human review, not legal conclusions.

findings.evidence: Accept: 'Accept All Cookies' (font: 16.0px, contrast: 3.77:1) vs Reject: 'Reject optional cookies' (font: 12.0px, contrast: 2.54:1)
findings.why: The Accept button uses high-contrast styling and visual prominence, whereas the Reject option is visually subdued, formatted as a faint link, or has inferior visual weight.
findings.safer_alternative: Present both 'Accept' and 'Reject' choices with equal visual weight, matching button shapes, and equivalent font styling.

consent_missing_reject.url: First layer only has Accept All and Manage Preferences; no direct Reject button
consent_missing_reject.disclaimer: ClearClick AI findings are automated warnings for human review, not legal conclusions.

findings.evidence: Accept option available ('Accept All') but no direct Reject button on first layer
findings.why: The first layer of the consent dialogue allows immediate agreement in one click, but forces users to navigate secondary menus to decline non-essential cookies.
findings.safer_alternative: Display a direct, equally accessible 'Reject Optional Cookies' button alongside 'Accept All'.

consent_double_negative.url: Confusing double-negative phrasing intentionally misleading user into keeping box checked
consent_double_negative.disclaimer: ClearClick AI findings are automated warnings for human review, not legal conclusions.

findings.evidence: do not wish to not receive
findings.why: The phrasing contains confusing double negatives ('do not wish to not receive') that may cause users to unintentionally agree to unwanted communications.
findings.safer_alternative: Use clear, direct affirmative wording such as 'Send me partner promotions' with an unchecked box.

charges_microprint_fee.url: Mandatory fee displayed in 8px micro-print font with low contrast grey text
charges_microprint_fee.disclaimer: ClearClick AI findings are automated warnings for human review, not legal conclusions.

findings.evidence: Fee disclosure: '*Excludes mandatory $45 resort and maintenance fee per night billed at front desk.' rendered at 8.0px (baseline headline: 38.0px)
findings.why: A mandatory surcharge or renewal cost is rendered in diminutive micro-print font, making it easy for users to miss the true cost before purchasing.
findings.safer_alternative: Display mandatory fees in standard, legible font size directly alongside the advertised headline rate.

findings.evidence: Fee: '*Excludes mandatory $45 resort and maintenance fee per night billed at front desk.' contrast is 2.56:1 (below WCAG 4.5:1 minimum on resolved background)
findings.why: Fee details are displayed using faint, low-contrast text against the background, impairing readability and obscuring the final price.
findings.safer_alternative: Render all pricing notices with at least 4.5:1 contrast against their background (WCAG AA compliant).

charges_low_contrast_fee.url: Fee printed in faint grey text on white background failing WCAG contrast standards
charges_low_contrast_fee.disclaimer: ClearClick AI findings are automated warnings for human review, not legal conclusions.

findings.evidence: Fee: '+ Mandatory processing fee: $48.50 and fuel surcharge: $22.00 applied at settlement' contrast is 1.42:1 (below WCAG 4.5:1 minimum on resolved background)
findings.why: Fee details are displayed using faint, low-contrast text against the background, impairing readability and obscuring the final price.
findings.safer_alternative: Render all pricing notices with at least 4.5:1 contrast against their background (WCAG AA compliant).

charges_drip_pricing.url: Significant late-appearing fee inflations added at final checkout step
charges_drip_pricing.disclaimer: ClearClick AI findings are automated warnings for human review, not legal conclusions.

findings.evidence: Advertised price $45.00 inflated to final total $76.55 via late-added fees: Electronic Delivery Fee: $9.50, Venue Facilities Fee: $14.25, Payment Processing Surcharge: $7.80
findings.why: The initial price displayed to the user is significantly lower than the final total due to compulsory fees added at the payment summary.
findings.safer_alternative: Quote an all-inclusive total upfront from the first step of the booking or checkout flow.

cancel_buried_link.url: Cancellation link hidden inside small-print footer text
cancel_buried_link.disclaimer: ClearClick AI findings are automated warnings for human review, not legal conclusions.

findings.evidence: Cancellation link: 'request cancellation of your account' rendered in 10.0px with color rgb(148, 163, 184) (contrast: 2.56:1)
findings.why: The cancellation mechanism is hidden in small, low-contrast text embedded within a paragraph or footer, making it substantially harder to locate than account upgrade actions.
findings.safer_alternative: Provide a clear, standard-sized 'Cancel Subscription' button with neutral styling in account management.

cancel_confirm_shaming.url: Manipulative guilt-tripping wording on cancellation opt-out button
cancel_confirm_shaming.disclaimer: ClearClick AI findings are automated warnings for human review, not legal conclusions.

findings.evidence: No thanks, I hate saving money and don't care about losing my data
findings.why: The cancellation decline option utilizes emotional manipulation and guilt-inducing phrasing ('confirm-shaming') to dissuade the user from cancelling.
findings.safer_alternative: Use neutral, objective action labels such as 'Proceed with Cancellation' or 'Keep My Plan'.

cancel_asymmetric_flow.url: Multi-step hurdle maze required to cancel compared to one-click signup
cancel_asymmetric_flow.disclaimer: ClearClick AI findings are automated warnings for human review, not legal conclusions.

findings.evidence: Multi-step cancellation process (Step 4 of 6) requiring 6 sequential screens
findings.why: Cancelling requires navigating a 6-step retention maze designed to introduce cognitive fatigue, while signing up typically takes 1 step.
findings.safer_alternative: Enable users to cancel with a straightforward process that matches signup simplicity (ideally 1 to 2 clear steps).
